title: 第152章 顺利生产第151章 测试微苜的特性
slug: 什么你说修真界大佬全都是我弟
content_zh:
纯粹的魔气对妄殊来说是唾手可得的东西。
而且就他们那“净化”魔气的方式，圣殿中人个个都是移动魔气储藏器，还愁没有魔气吗。
自然是很快便将她需要的魔气给她送过来了。
对微苜的改造已经完成得差不多，夏以苜的研究内容又回到了如何激活净化魔气的“基因”上。
时间距离朱清棠生产也只剩下了一个月。
对慕黎几人来说，好似朱清棠顺利生下孩子，一切便皆大欢喜了。
一个月之后，他们便可放下身上的那些包袱。
不必担心慕黎会被朱家追杀，也不必担心慕衍仙尊会杀回来。
因此，每一个人都热切期盼着朱清棠的孩子降生。
夏以苜沉浸式研究的时候，总是觉得时间过得很快。
当她完成今日的研究后，算了算时间，才想起来明日之后便是朱清棠的预产期了。
这样的大事，夏以苜觉得自己还是去阵影宗陪着比较好。
这三个月的日子太过平静，有些事情顺利得有些不可思议。
虽然没有在修真界内找到慕衍仙尊神魂的踪迹，可她隐隐还是有些担心。
慕衍仙尊这种在小说里都可以当幕后大boss的人，死得有点太轻松了。
若慕衍仙尊的神魂当真还在，她是慕衍仙尊，想要报复朱清棠和慕黎，大概率会选择在朱清棠生产的那一日。
不管怎样，还是亲自去一趟要安心一些。
第二日，夏以苜便暂且放下了手中的事情，和林朔风、云辞一起去了阵影宗。
“姐，我在这附近都布好了阵法，任何人想要来捣乱都得先过我阵法那一关。”
“还有，若是慕衍仙尊的神魂出现，我也为他准备好了阵法，他若是有胆子来，便让他尝尝自己的阵法是什么滋味。”慕黎故作凶狠地说着。

随后挠了挠头，“不过……我觉得慕衍仙尊的神魂应该已经轮回或者消失了吧，都已经过了这么久了，还没有出现。”
“他那样的人，哪里能忍受别人占着他的身体，享受他的修炼成果，肯定早就来和我抢夺身体了。”
对于自己搜查的结果，慕黎还是很有自信的。
夏以苜沉思着开口：“不知为何，我心中总有些不安，还是小心为上吧。”
“姐，朱家也派了不少人来这里守着，朱伯父和朱伯母也都来了，清棠一定能顺利生产，你莫要担心。”林朔风出声安慰着。
他们的防护工作已经做得很好，即便慕衍仙尊的神魂真的出现了，也不可能靠近朱清棠。
想到这里，夏以苜便也放宽了心，过度紧张反而不好。
云辞脚步匆匆赶过来，“姐姐，朱清棠发动了！”
此刻接近傍晚，一行人立即行动起来。
慕黎去外面坐镇，夏以苜几人则是去产房外守着。
产房里有朱母陪着朱清棠，他们也不便进去。
因为夏以苜的提醒，慕黎几人都提起警惕，心中也不免多了几分紧张。
朱清棠的体质很好，生产的过程很顺利，受的罪也很少。
content_en:
Pure demonic energy is something that is easily available to Wanshu.
And based on their method of "purifying" demonic energy, everyone in the temple has a mobile demonic energy storage device, so they still worry about not having demonic energy.
Naturally, the demonic energy she needed was quickly sent to her.
The transformation of Weilu has almost been completed, and Xia Yilu's research has returned to how to activate the "gene" that purifies demonic energy.
There is only one month left before Zhu Qingtang gives birth.
To the people in Mu Li, it seemed that Zhu Qingtang had successfully given birth to a child, and everything was happy.
After a month, they can let go of the baggage they carry.
There is no need to worry that Mu Li will be hunted down by the Zhu family, and there is no need to worry that Immortal Mu Yan will come back.
Therefore, everyone is eagerly looking forward to the birth of Zhu Qingtang's child.
When Xia Yiming was immersed in research, he always felt that time passed quickly.
After she finished today's research, she counted the time and remembered that Zhu Qingtang's due date would be after tomorrow.
For such a big event, Xia Yihuo thought it would be better for him to go to the Formation Shadow Sect to accompany him.
These three months have been too peaceful, and some things have gone incredibly smoothly.
Although there was no trace of the soul of Immortal Mu Yan in the world of cultivation, she was still a little worried.
Mu Yanxianzun, a person who could be the big boss behind the scenes in novels, died a little too easily.
If Immortal Mu Yan's soul is really still there, she is Immortal Mu Yan and wants to take revenge on Zhu Qingtang and Mu Li, so she will most likely choose the day when Zhu Qingtang gives birth.
No matter what, it would be safer to go there in person.
On the second day, Xia Yihuang put aside what he was doing and went to the Shadow Array Sect with Lin Shuofeng and Yun Ci.
"Sister, I have set up formations around here. Anyone who wants to cause trouble must pass my formation first."
"Also, if the soul of Immortal Lord Mu Yan appears, I have also prepared the formation for him. If he has the courage to come, I will let him taste what my own formation is like." Mu Li said in a pretentious manner.
Then he scratched his head and said, "But... I think Mu Yanxianzun's soul should have reincarnated or disappeared. It has been so long and it has not appeared yet."
"How could a person like him tolerate others occupying his body and enjoying the fruits of his cultivation? He would definitely have come to snatch his body from me a long time ago."
Mu Li was still very confident about the results of his search.
Xia Yihuo said thoughtfully: "I don't know why, but I always feel a little uneasy. It's better to be careful."
"Sister, the Zhu family also sent many people here to guard her. Uncle Zhu and Aunt Zhu are also here. Qingtang will definitely give birth smoothly. Don't worry." Lin Shuofeng comforted her.
Their protection work has been done very well. Even if Mu Yanxianzun's spirit really appears, it will not be able to get close to Zhu Qingtang.
Thinking of this, Xia Yiming relaxed. Being too nervous would be bad.
Yun Ci hurried over, "Sister, Zhu Qingtang has started!"
It was approaching evening, and the group immediately took action.
Mu Li went to sit outside, while Xia Yishu and others went to guard outside the delivery room.
Zhu Qingtang was accompanied by Zhu's mother in the delivery room, so it was inconvenient for them to enter.
Because of Xia Yishu's reminder, everyone in Mu Li was on guard, and they couldn't help but feel a little more nervous.
Zhu Qingtang's physique was very good, the birth process went smoothly, and she suffered very little.
